versions.changelog:
- Added support for Chinese article files with both `-zh-hans.md` and legacy `-chn.md` suffixes.
- Updated documentation to clarify handling of Chinese counterparts and legacy file naming.
- Removed redundant/obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Removed the Arch Linux logo glyph () from the sign-off line and all related instructions.
- Updated the sign-off insertion and verification procedures to use plain text: btw, i use arch.
- Simplified Python and shell command examples to match the new plain sign-off.
- Deleted the redundant skill-card.md file for clarity.

- Improved sign-off insertion procedure: requires using a Python one-liner to reliably add the Arch glyph (U+F303), preventing silent character loss.
- Added verification instructions using `xxd` to ensure U+F303 is present in the file, not just visually.
- Clarified that visual confirmation is unreliable; users must use a hex check.
- Removed the unnecessary file `skill-card.md`.

Initial release of arch-sign-off.

- Appends the Arch Linux sign-off line btw, i use arch  to the bottom of every article in ai-thoughts/docs/, unless the user explicitly opts out.
- The sign-off is always in English and includes the  glyph.
- Applies to both English and Chinese (`-chn.md`) article versions, without translation.
- Prevents duplicate sign-off lines.
- Skips non-article files and respects user instructions not to append the sign-off.
